feeds.title: Anti-Age Magazine
feeds.description: Anti Age Magazine is the first and the leading magazine for anti-aging medicine and medical aesthetics. Here you can find all the information you are looking for on cosmetic surgery or cosmetic medicine.

feeds.title: Premium Beauty News
feeds.description: PremiumBeautyNews.com is a website devoted to professionals of the cosmetics and beauty industries and related sectors. PremiumBeautyNews.com selects and analyzes news from an international point of view and focuses on the information that may impact the international trade of cosmetic products or affect the industry at a global level.

feeds.title: Kodd Magazine » Beauty
feeds.description: Discover all the articles, videos, files, slideshows. All the info is on kodd-magazine.com! KODD is a magazine whose aim is to highlight creatives, brands, and companies that share our ideal of excellence. We promote actors from the fields of fashion, beauty, and culture.

feeds.title: Alpol le Magazine
feeds.description: Thanks to more than 70 years of expertise in the cosmetic field, ALPOL Cosmétique supports you every day in your project. With 'Le mag' we decrypt sector news for you and let you know all about news and changes. Through 4 thematics, you can trust our opinions and eye expert to know and understand everything! Market, consumer and product trends, regulatory changes, etc: everything will be known about designing the product of the future!

feeds.title: Joleen Emory Blog
feeds.description: I'm Joleen, a Franco-American makeup artist in Paris, France. Originally from California, I've been traveling and creating beauty around the world for many years. Whether I'm with you on your wedding day or working on an editorial photoshoot, I'm passionate about what I do.

feeds.title: Superga Beauty
feeds.description: Superga Beauty is a family business that has managed to maintain a human scale. Our 6 industrial sites in France and our strategic international presence allow us to be agile and, above all, to meet all the demands of beauty brands. We offer global solutions for the creation of perfumes, skincare, and make-up, with a flexible and competitive 'time to market'

feeds.title: Greentech
feeds.description: Pioneer in plant biotechnology, GREENTECH develops and produces for cosmetic, pharmaceutical, and nutraceutical fields high-tech active ingredients from plant, marine, and microbial worlds.

feeds.title: Codage Paris Blogs
feeds.description: Thanks to Codage expertise, learn to listen to your skin, to understand it, to decode it. CODAGE Paris is a contemporary cosmetology house, with a skin nutrition approach, a pioneer in tailor-made products.
